nanu.cp: ind. (particle of affirmation) is it not? Certain; surely
nanu.p: နု ဒ တိ၊ Nuda + egg. Thoma. These verses are: (1) taking the will, (2) asking, (3) anticipating, (4) manifesting, completing, (5) blaming, (6) deciding, (7) allowing, (8) not being angry. Calling (10) The opposite.

B:
nanu： nanu（bya）
နနု（ဗျ）
[na nudati，nuda+u．thoma．（nanu-saṃ，ṇaṇu-prā）]
[န နုဒတိ၊ နုဒ+ဥ။ ထောမ။ （နနု-သံ၊ ဏဏု-ပြာ）]
C: nanu：[ind．] （particle of affirmation） is it not? Certain； surely nanda ：[adj．] rejoicing．
P: Nanu，（indecl．） [Ved．nanu] 1．part．of affirmation （cp．na<sup>1</sup>）：surely，certainly Pv．II，6<sup>7</sup> （so to be read for nanda? v．l．BB nuna）； Manor．Pūr．on A．V，194 （Andersen P．R．91）．-- 2．part．of interrogation （=Lat．nonne） “is it not” （cp．na<sup>2</sup>）：J．I，151； III，393； DhA．I，33．（Page 346）
I: nanu：A particle generally used in asking questions to which an affirmative answer is expected，i．e．，nanu passasi，do you not see?
R:
nanu：န-နု （အ）
မဟုတ်လော။ စင်စစ်။ စောဒနာဦးအံ့။
နနု အပ္ပမတေ္တဟိ ဘဝိတဗ္ဗံ၊ မမေ့မလျော့ခြင်းတို့ဖြင့်် ဖြစ်ထိုက်သည် မဟုတ်ပါလော။ နနု မယာ တုယှံ အဘယံ ဒိန္နံ၊ အကျွန်ုပ်သည် အသင့်အား ဘေးမဲ့ကို ပေးပြီးသည် မဟုတ်တုံလော။
DOP: nanu ind. [na 2 + nu 1 ; ts ], not; is it not? certainly, surely ; Abh 1139 (nanu kacci nu kiṃ); 1151 (virodhakathane nanu); 1192; Vin III 16, 6 (nanu nāma tāta Sudinna sakaṃ gehaṃ gantabban ti); 19, 34 (nanu āvuso bhagavatā anekapariyāyena virāgāya dhammo desito no sarāgāya; Sp 217, 15 : nanū ti anumatigahaṇatthe nipāto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee nanu iti); D II 144, 10 (nanu etaṃ Ānanda mayā paṭikacc’ eva akkhātaṃ sabbeh’ eva piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo); M I 463, 29 (nanu tumhe Anuruddhā evaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā ti); Pv 8:4 (nanu tvaṃ yeva dummatī ti); Th 1108 (nanu ahaṃ citta tayāmhi yācito); Ja I 151, 15 (nanu mayā tuyhaṃ abhayaṃ dinnaṃ, kasmā tvaṃ idha nipanno ti); II 268, 7* (nanu maṃ suhadayo ti maññasi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee hadaye ’timaññasi); 350, 15* (nanu passasi ’maṃ kāḷiṃ … kokilaṃ); Bv 2:218 (nanu rittā sabbasaṅkhārā); Mil 52, 2 (nanu taṃ ubhato chinnaṃ atthaṃ gacchatī ti); Vism 298, 11 (nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā); Pv-a 136, 27 (nanu ca devānaṃ jīvitaṃ paricchinnappamāṇaṃ vuttaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr nanūpadevānaṃ); Bv-a 84, 5 (ayuttaṃ nanū ti nāyuttaṃ); Sadd 93, 1 (nanu vinayo buddha-vacanaṃ); 896, 3 (kacci nu nanu icc ete pucchanatthe); 902, 11 (nanu ca iti accantavirodhe).
NCP: indeclinable (particle of affirmation) not; is it not? certain; surely.
